UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents the user profile containing chanting meditation metrics, streaks, settings, and acquired milestones

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the practitioner

displayName.description: The custom displayed profile name chosen by the user

email.description: The verified email of the practitioner

totalChants.description: Cumulative chant count completed across all sessions securely audited on the backend

currentStreak.description: Consecutive days where chanting count was non-zero

maxStreak.description: Inspirational personal record for max daily streak achieved

milestonesEarned.description: Collection of unique unlocked reward milestone keys

targetDailyGoal.description: Personal daily chant goal target. Standard baseline is a mala (108 repetitions)

lastChantedAt.description: Precise server-sync unix milliseconds timestamp of the last valid chant repetition

dailyChantCounts.description: Key-value pair indexing Gregorian date-keys (YYYY-MM-DD) to total chant counts recorded on that date

users/{userId}.description: Collection mapping authenticated practitioners to their persistent, verified chanting meditation stats
